newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 5.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 5.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors affecting Indian stock markets on Thursday morning:
** Finance ministry officials to meet chiefs of three investment financial institutions on Friday to discuss sluggish markets, The Economic Times says
** Market regulator, Securities and Exchange Board of India says will permit 100 percent investment by foreign institutional investors in debt securities
** Securities firm ING Barings said on Wednesday it lowered its 1996/97 (April-March) and 1997/98 earnings estimates for Indian truckmaker TELCO

"In line with our view of recessionary trends in the economy in general and a slowdown in the automobile sector in particular, we are downgrading our numbers on TELCO," ING Barings said in a note to investors
** Bajaj Auto plans to set up third scooter plant in Pune in India's western Maharashtra state, Economic Times says

** Investors must be alert for a minor bottom at 2770-2730 points as the decline of the benchmark Bombay stocks index shows signs of weakening, a technical analyst at finance firm Times Guaranty said on Wednesday
"The market has lost 95.09 points over the weekend close of 2890.50. The index is at its three-year low, has made tops and bottoms," technical analyst Mehmood Khan said in a note
But he said the downtrend was showing signs of weakening
** Indian rupee INR= slips to 35.86 per dollar from 35.82/83 opening, dealers say
** Indian GDRs skid in thin London trade on Wednesday as cement, steel and automakers are pounded for the third day
** Indian stocks take a beating on Wednesday and key Bombay share index .BSESN dives 52.94 pts to 2,745.06, off day's low of 2713.12
** National index falls 2.6 pct, Delhi 1.6 pct to 622.74, Calcutta 0.53 pct to 390.0 and Madras 0.84 pct to 2,868
